{
  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": ["C000", "F001"],
        "scope_text": "When an agency officer authorizes an outdoor demonstration during an active storm warning.",
        "context_quotes": ["C000", "C001", "F000"],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F001",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "An authorization granted by an agency officer for an outdoor demonstration during an active storm warning expires when that warning ends, and it does not authorize demonstrations under a later warning."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "recommendation",
        "scope_quotes": ["F002"],
        "scope_text": "For displays held entirely before sunset.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "should",
        "modality": "should",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F002"],
        "scope_text": "For displays held entirely before sunset where the organizer is recommended to place a readable map near the entrance.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "The recommendation to place a readable map near the entrance for displays held entirely before sunset does not create a duty to illuminate exits after sunset."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F003"],
        "scope_text": "After the display closes.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes, with weekends and holidays counting toward the 30 days."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F003"],
        "scope_text": "After the display closes, if an investigation is open when the 30-calendar-day retention period ends.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "If an investigation is open when the 30-calendar-day retention period after the display closes ends, the organizer must retain the inspection record until the agency closes the investigation."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F004",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [],
        "scope_text": "",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "not required",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F004",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "Visitors are not required to supply their home addresses."
      }
    },
